actual_english_branches.english_text:
Repair the control terminal first. Place materials or empty equipment in Intake, then press the relevant contribution button. Equipment becomes a permanent part of the farm. Remove its contents and modules first.

Terminal repairs accept partial contributions. Other modules level up from donated equipment. Each hydroponic system adds one plot; terminal level limits active plots.

Seeds retain their grids and genetics. Protect individual seeds. Terminal II unlocks sequential planting and recycling six surplus seeds into one nutrient tablet. Protected or queued seeds are excluded. Selection chances: III 10%, IV 30%.

Water grades are stored separately. Choose the source and target purification grades and preferred supply grade. All grades are available for supply. Rechargers generate 10 energy/day and power arrays 15; commercial power doubles both. Donated batteries permanently add capacity, up to 10,000 additional energy.

The warehouse stores crops and husbandry products by item count, retaining freshness and quality. Withdrawals go to the export tray; anything that cannot fit stays inside.

Cages and RAS units add separate husbandry space, retaining existing expansions. New units open independent areas first. Maximum six pages of 12x8 cells. Areas can be dismantled without refunding equipment, expansions or contents. Expand the selected area using one metal ingot from Intake. Donate an auto butcher to unlock native slaughter settings for each area.

Water, energy or feed shortages safely pause the affected area. Full storage pauses harvest and slaughter. Stored food still spoils normally. The Real Hydroponic Farmer start has a weekly Eleanor contract and a dedicated storyline. Find the contract in Overview. Terminal V supports supertech crops. See the Crop Handbook for culture requirements.

Accepts ordinary and supertech crops. Original battery, modules, seed, culture and output slots are retained. Built-in +100% to all three stats stacks with modules.

Star-Marrow Orchid: 14 days, 500 mL completely pure water/cycle; up to 6 flowers.
Mimic Flower: 16 days, 200 mL water-free culture/cycle; 4-8 flowers.
Fatewheel Tree: 30 days, 100 mL dry components/cycle, no liquids; 1 fruit.

Times assume standard speed; performance shortens them. Each harvest returns one seed. Invalid environments pause without culture or power consumption. Genes cannot be modified; produce has standard size only.

Also grows in a terminal-V Integrated Farm. Non-water crops receive no automatic water or nutrients; prepare and dry cultures manually.

Strongest does not always mean best.

Factory notes. Read before starting.

Dryer: powder. Conditioner: paste. Extractor: essence. Insert one species and press Start. Small/normal/large/huge crops contribute 5/10/20/30; 100 yields one unit. Sizes may mix; species keep separate balances. These three machines need no electricity.

Refined paste uses 10mL base per unit to raise or lower one existing note by one. Refined essence uses 10mL acid to remove one note. At least one must remain. Shortages pause work.

Each row holds three ingredients: powder A, paste B, essence C. See page 3 for reactions, page 4 for fusion pairs and page 5 for priorities.

The blender costs 16 energy per run, overnight. Each chemical module opens a row, up to five, at the same cost. Turbos handle rush orders.

actual_english_branches.english_text:
Process slots 1 + 2, then their result + slot 3. The second reaction TYPE uses the original forms in slots 2 and 3. Changing positions can change the result.

Each step first merges notes, taking the higher shared level, then applies ONE reaction:
AA: keep merged notes.
AB / BA: shared levels become their absolute difference.
AC / CA: weakest -1, strongest +1.
BB: add levels of shared notes.
BC / CB: use the fusion table.
CC: keep notes and add rot.

Support leaves a single note unchanged. The ingredient forms choose the reaction; types do not compete.

Subtract the weaker level from BOTH source notes. The output takes that level, or its existing level if higher. Do not add them. Other notes remain.

Example: Floral 4, Green 2, Fruit 1 becomes Floral 2, Fruit 2. Green is exhausted.

No match: keep merged notes. Only ONE pair fuses per step; do not chain the table.

actual_english_branches.english_text:
Fusion priority
Use only the earliest matching table row. Floral + Green wins over Floral + Spice when all three are present. A later fusion step checks the table again from the top.

Support ties
Floral > Green > Fruit > Honey > Wood > Spice > Smoke > Metal.
Pick weakest and strongest independently from the pre-support notes. Ties choose the earliest note. If both pick the same note, -1 then +1 cancels out. Ignore zero levels.

Bottling priority
After both steps: qualifying complex kinds first, then higher BASE factory price, then earlier standards listing on a tie. Quality premiums do not affect selection. No match yields Custom Perfume.
